headline: NACCO Industries Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
summary: NACCO Industries (NYSE:NC) reported stronger operating performance across its utility coal mining, contract mining and minerals and royalties businesses in the second quarter of 2026, but solar-project impairment charges drove the company to a consolidated operating loss and net loss for the period.
